summary: Abetment of suicide case under Section 306 IPC; proximate link between alleged harassment and suicide questioned; FIR registered 24 hours after death; investigation deemed unidimensional; no evidence of specific abetment or mens rea; reliance on Swamy Prahaladdas precedent; charge-sheet quashed for failure to establish essential ingredients of Section 306 IPC; proceedings held unsustainable due to lack of incitement evidence.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; charge-sheet and criminal proceedings quashed; cognizance order set aside.
